key_points: Routine 2.5-2.7% share-price decline driven by ~4% drop in crude oil prices
No earnings, guidance, regulatory, M&A, or major operational news in headlines
Analyst target-price comparisons and peer-versus-peer articles are recurring commentary, not catalysts
Exxon carbon-capture expansion is XOM-specific and not directly material to OXY
Price action reflects short-term oil-beta correlation, not a fundamental shift in thesis
